evidence.detail: HEAD exactly matched the launcher target and the working tree was clean: 9c01749b221d6f7f2d8ff9ca6282cf9172477a3d.
M2 traceability maps all five approved roadmap work items (ISSUE-0007 through ISSUE-0011) to implementation, tests, handoffs, and issue reviews.

Independent full-suite execution could not complete: socket-based tests failed because the read-only review environment denied loopback binding. The recorded repository evidence reports 173 passing tests at the candidate.
Independent governance validation could not complete because the read-only environment provided no writable temporary directory.
Python compilation completed successfully at the reviewed SHA.

The implementation contains dual-mode authentication, strict app-only tenant/client/secret validation, fixed error mapping, session renewal, logout/supersession cleanup, loopback Host/Origin controls, and UI secret clearing; focused auth, graph, and UI tests executed successfully before one incorrectly named test module caused the focused command to exit nonzero.
evidence.reference: auth.py; server.py; web/app.js; tests/test_auth.py; tests/test_server.py; tests/test_ui_safety.py

evidence.detail: README and security-boundary documentation describe both modes, app-registration prerequisites, secret retention and transmission, rotation/revocation, least privilege limitations, and the absence of live-tenant verification.

evidence: CURRENT.md says the milestone candidate is frozen at 98be0bc562de8f7cf52e3019715bc4cff571ad91 and that all four reviews have not yet run, while the launcher-bound candidate is 9c01749b221d6f7f2d8ff9ca6282cf9172477a3d and M2.md records a completed, superseded Codex general review against b55bf97ff4a4f850a21390443581e26e22f3179a.

AGENTS.md requires CURRENT.md to be the authoritative current-state index, to link current-gate evidence, and to name the exact reviewed candidate and next permitted action. It expressly requires stale or contradictory records to block rather than be inferred around.
findings.remediation: Update CURRENT.md so the exact milestone review candidate, review history, iteration state, evidence limitations, and next permitted action agree with M2.md and the launcher-bound SHA. Because the permitted general-remediation budget appears exhausted, obtain the exact human workflow decision required by the repository rules before creating another candidate.
findings.title: Authoritative current-state record is stale and contradicts the review candidate
findings.verification: At the resulting exact commit, compare CURRENT.md, M2.md, git HEAD, all four report identities, and launcher binding; then rerun the governance validator and all required milestone reviews if a new candidate is authorized.

evidence: M2.md records that a Codex general review found a REQUIRED defect against b55bf97ff4a4f850a21390443581e26e22f3179a, that the defect was repaired in the present candidate, and that the earlier review was invalidated.

The same record nevertheless reports zero general-remediation cycles used and calls the repair an in-flight correction. AGENTS.md states that any relevant documentation change invalidates a review, permits at most one milestone general-remediation cycle, and says a remaining required change after that cycle blocks for a human decision. It provides no metadata-only or incomplete-four-report exception.
findings.remediation: Record the b55bf97ff4a4-to-9c01749 repair as the one permitted general-remediation cycle and correct the loop iteration accounting. Since F-001 remains on the repaired candidate, stop and request the exact human decision mandated by the exhausted general-remediation limit; do not silently create another candidate or waive the finding.
findings.title: Milestone record incorrectly resets the consumed general-remediation budget
findings.verification: Confirm the milestone record counts the initial review and repair consistently with AGENTS.md and docs/workflow.md, identifies the exhausted general-remediation budget, and records the human's explicit decision before any further candidate or review run.

limitations: The launcher supplied no base commit, and the isolated target commit has no available parent, so a base-to-target milestone diff could not be inspected; review used the complete target tree, roadmap traceability, issue records, handoffs, and retained reports.
The full 173-test suite could not be independently completed because the review sandbox forbids loopback socket binding; failures occurred during HTTP-test setup rather than assertions.
Governance validation could not be independently completed because no writable temporary directory was available.
Live device-code and app-only tenant sign-in were not performed; repository records classify them as protected actions and known residual evidence gaps.
No browser-automation tool was available; UI behavior was assessed from source, static tests, and recorded manual walkthrough evidence.
review.summary: M2 is blocked. Product implementation and documentation are substantially traceable, compilation succeeded, and no new product defect was established, but the authoritative status record is stale and the milestone record incorrectly treats a finding-driven candidate repair as consuming no general-remediation cycle. Under the repository's bounded workflow, that cycle is already used and the remaining required governance correction now requires an explicit human decision. Independent full-suite and governance checks were also unavailable in the read-only sandbox.
